title: Prepositions after nouns
summary: Существительные с предлогами: **reason for, cause of, solution to, increase in, effect on, difference between**, а также различие **increase in / increase of** и **advantage of / over**.
ru:
## Существительное + предлог: учим сочетаниями
Как и с глаголами, предлог после существительного нужно запоминать вместе со словом. Часто он совпадает с предлогом родственного глагола или прилагательного (*interested in → interest in*, *depend on → dependence on*), но не всегда: *proud of*, но *pride in*; *solve a problem*, но *a solution to a problem*. Если сомневаетесь, держите в голове частые пары и проверяйте их по словарю.

## Самые частые сочетания
- **for**: *a reason for, a demand for, a need for, a preference for, responsibility for, talent for, a cure for, an excuse for.*
> There is a growing **demand for** skilled engineers. — Растёт спрос на квалифицированных инженеров.
> What is the **reason for** this delay? — В чём причина этой задержки?
- **of**: *a cause of, a lack of, a shortage of, knowledge of, an example of, a member of, the cost of.* **cause of** (причина последствия: *the cause of the fire*) vs **reason for** (причина действия: *the reason for the delay*).
- **to**: *a solution to, an answer to, a reply to, a key to, access to, damage to, an invitation to, a reaction to, an introduction to, an approach to, an attitude to / towards.*
> The **solution to** the problem was surprisingly simple. — Решение проблемы оказалось на удивление простым.
> They have no **access to** clean water. — У них нет доступа к чистой воде.
- **in**: *an increase / rise / fall / decrease in, interest in, belief in, confidence in, trust in, a delay in, success in.*

## Изменение: in и of
Когда говорим об изменении величины, **in** называет предмет изменения, а **of** — размер изменения.
> an **increase in** prices — рост цен; an **increase of** 5% — рост на 5%.
> There was a **rise of** 8% **in** unemployment. — Безработица выросла на 8%.
> a **fall in** the number of tourists — сокращение числа туристов.

## Между, на, с: отношения и воздействие
- **between**: *a difference / link / connection / relationship / contrast between A and B*; но **difference in** price/size (в чём) и **difference between** (между чем): *a difference in price between the two hotels.*
- **with**: *a problem / trouble / contact / relationship with*, *a connection with* (с кем-то) — *Do you have any contact with him?*
- **on**: *an effect / influence / impact on, a report / book / comment / opinion on, a tax on, a restriction on, an attack on.*
> Social media has a huge **effect on** teenagers. — Соцсети сильно влияют на подростков.
> **The effect of** noise **on** concentration — влияние шума на концентрацию.
Влияние: **effect of X on Y**, **influence on / over**, **impact on**.

## Сравнение, преимущество и отношение
**advantage of** (+ -ing) = выгода: *the advantage of living in the city*; **advantage over** = перевес над соперником: *a clear advantage over our rivals*; **advantage in** — в области. **attitude to / towards** — отношение к чему-то; **comparison between / with / of**; **opinion of / on / about**: *What is your opinion of the plan?*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~the cause for the accident~~ → the cause **of** the accident (но *cause for concern*)
- ~~a demand of electric cars~~ → a demand **for** electric cars
- ~~a damage of the roof~~ → damage **to** the roof (damage — неисчисляемое, без a)
- ~~the key of success~~ → the key **to** success
- ~~a difference of price between~~ → a difference **in** price between
en:
## Noun + preposition: learn them as combinations
As with verbs, the preposition after a noun has to be learned together with the word. It often matches the preposition of the related verb or adjective (*interested in → interest in*, *depend on → dependence on*), but not always: *proud of*, but *pride in*; *solve a problem*, but *a solution to a problem*. If you are unsure, keep the common pairs in mind and check a dictionary.

## The most common combinations
- **for**: *a reason for, a demand for, a need for, a preference for, responsibility for, a talent for, a cure for, an excuse for.*
> There is a growing **demand for** skilled engineers.
> What is the **reason for** this delay?
- **of**: *a cause of, a lack of, a shortage of, knowledge of, an example of, a member of, the cost of.* **cause of** (the origin of a result: *the cause of the fire*) vs **reason for** (the explanation of an action: *the reason for the delay*).
- **to**: *a solution to, an answer to, a reply to, a key to, access to, damage to, an invitation to, a reaction to, an introduction to, an approach to, an attitude to / towards.*
> The **solution to** the problem was surprisingly simple.
> They have no **access to** clean water.
- **in**: *an increase / rise / fall / decrease in, interest in, belief in, confidence in, trust in, a delay in, success in.*

## Change: in and of
When we talk about a change in size, **in** names the thing that changes and **of** gives the amount.
> an **increase in** prices; an **increase of** 5%.
> There was a **rise of** 8% **in** unemployment.
> a **fall in** the number of tourists.

## Between, on, with: relationship and effect
- **between**: *a difference / link / connection / relationship / contrast between A and B*; but **difference in** price/size (in what) and **difference between** (between what): *a difference in price between the two hotels.*
- **with**: *a problem / trouble / contact / relationship with*, *a connection with* (a person) — *Do you have any contact with him?*
- **on**: *an effect / influence / impact on, a report / book / comment / opinion on, a tax on, a restriction on, an attack on.*
> Social media has a huge **effect on** teenagers.
> **The effect of** noise **on** concentration.
For influence use **effect of X on Y**, **influence on / over**, **impact on**.

## Comparison, advantage and attitude
**advantage of** (+ -ing) = a benefit: *the advantage of living in the city*; **advantage over** = superiority to someone: *a clear advantage over our rivals*; **advantage in** — in a field. **attitude to / towards**; **comparison between / with / of**; **opinion of / on / about**: *What is your opinion of the plan?*

## Common mistakes
- ~~the cause for the accident~~ → the cause **of** the accident (but *cause for concern*)
- ~~a demand of electric cars~~ → a demand **for** electric cars
- ~~a damage of the roof~~ → damage **to** the roof (damage is uncountable, no a)
- ~~the key of success~~ → the key **to** success
- ~~a difference of price between~~ → a difference **in** price between
structure:
## Существительные по предлогу
| Предлог | Существительные | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| for | reason, demand, need, cure, talent, preference, responsibility | a need for change |
| of | cause, lack, shortage, knowledge, example, cost | a lack of funding |
| to | solution, answer, reply, key, access, damage, invitation, reaction, attitude | access to data |
| in | increase, rise, fall, interest, belief, confidence, delay | an increase in sales |
| on | effect, impact, influence, report, tax, restriction, comment | an impact on health |
| with | problem, trouble, contact, relationship | trouble with the printer |
| between | difference, link, connection, contrast, comparison | a link between stress and sleep |

## in и of при изменении
> an **increase / rise / fall in** + что меняется
> an **increase / rise / fall of** + на сколько
> a **rise of** 3% **in** prices

## Пары по смыслу
| Сочетание | Значение |
|---|---|
| cause of | причина (следствия) |
| reason for | причина (действия, события) |
| advantage of -ing | выгода |
| advantage over sb | перевес над кем-то |
| difference in | в чём (price, size) |
| difference between | между чем |

exercises.title: Вставьте предлог
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужный предлог. В скобках — варианты, из которых нужно выбрать.

items.text: There is a growing demand {{for}} skilled engineers.
Researchers are looking for a solution {{to}} the housing crisis.
What was the reason {{for}} the delay?
Smoking is a major cause {{of}} lung disease.
There has been a sharp rise {{in}} unemployment this year.
Many people have little access {{to}} clean drinking water.
Her attitude {{to|towards}} money is quite relaxed.
Social media has had a huge effect {{on}} teenagers.
The company announced an increase {{of}} eight per cent {{in}} its annual profits.
She has a real talent {{for}} languages.
There is a significant difference {{between}} British and American spelling.
The invitation {{to}} the ceremony arrived last week.
He showed no interest {{in}} the offer.
Her research focuses on the relationship {{between}} sleep and memory.
We had trouble {{with}} the software all morning.
The lack {{of}} funding forced the museum to close.
The new model has a clear advantage {{over}} the older one.
